legalRisks.title: Paying Students
legalRisks.question: Is there any legal concern around rewards being monetary value?
legalRisks.response: We are not directly sending money to minors, at least not yet. Parental approval and verification is something we can gain in order to accomplish this. Venmo and other apps allow sending of money between minors, and minors can have bank accounts with parental approval.

legalRisks.title: Cryptocurrency
legalRisks.question: Are there any legal barriers to providing students with cryptocurrency or coins?
legalRisks.response: We will not be using cryptocurrency, at least initially or as the primary variant of the game. Currency is simply digital points. There should be no legal barrier, all games are giving players coins.
mitigations: Not using real cryptocurrency, at least not initially

legalRisks.title: Payment to Minors Restrictions
legalRisks.question: What are the restrictions on payment to minors?
legalRisks.response: Kids can only open accounts at 13-18 with a parent or 18+. Payment to kids is restricted on Venmo but allowed on Cash App at 13. Lots of data is required to open a bank account with a kid.
mitigations: Partner with existing minor-friendly payment platforms
